messages:
zoe_marketing: Quick request for launch materials  we need a tiny bench smoke pack for the blog + webinar. Can runtime run a compact protocol and share a CSV + one demo trace?

zoe_marketing: Details: 500 anonymized samples stratified by length (short/med/long), run fp16 and int8, coldstart vs warmed (3 warmups), measure gen p50/p95/p99, tokens/sec, and est cost per 1M tokens. Also include embed p95 for the med slice.

sam_runtime: We can do that. Two quick q's: 1) which model names should we cite? 2) do you want staging or prod runs?

zoe_marketing: Use `redwood-v1-base` for gen and `redwood-embed-v1` for embeds. Staging is fine but note GPU type in the writeup.

nina_eng-runtime: Running on staging (A10g). Plan: 3 repeats per variant, coldstart uses pod restart, warm = 3 warmup requests per worker. We'll push bundle to s3.

deploy-bot: Job scheduled: bench-mini-1789995555 on staging at 2025-05-09T11:10:00Z. id: bench-mini-1789995555.

sam_runtime: Coldstart prelim: gen p95 fp16 = 290ms(short), 510ms(med), 1250ms(long). int8 ~12% lower on med. No OOMs.

zoe_marketing: Nice. Can you capture the micro-run for 256-token median and paste numbers for the slide?

sam_runtime: Micro-run med=256 tokens (median of 3): fp16 p95=505ms, int8 p95=445ms, tps fp16=230, tps int8=270, est cost/1M tokens fp16=$11.90, int8=$10.50. CSV and trace uploaded.

jules_product: For product blurb, can we add a short note: "Staging numbers; prod expected to improve on A100-class GPUs"?

nina_eng-runtime: Added note to summary and included runner config + seed list in bundle. s3://redwood-staging/bench-mini-1789995555/bundle.zip.

zoe_marketing: Perfect  thanks team. We'll draft the copy and tag you for sign-off. Please keep the runner config in the bundle so we can repro the demo on demand. :sparkles:
